_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.src: Return to the Dogun village with a Dogun Badge of Trust and talk to the leader of the town
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.dst: Dogun Badge of Trust를 가지고 Dogun 마을로 돌아가 마을 지도자에게 말을 거세요

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.src: You are so young.. to be fighting.. a war so old. Still... it is appreciated.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.dst: 그렇게 어린데.. 그토록 오래된.. 전쟁을 치르다니. 그래도... 고맙게 여긴다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.src: The war... to you, it would be... ages ago. But... when one has lived for... {~} years...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.dst: 그 전쟁은... 너에게는... 까마득한 옛일이겠지. 하지만... {~}년을... 살아온 자에게는...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.src: We have... few options. We need to discuss... the few we have... available.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.dst: 우리에겐... 선택지가 적다. 남은... 몇 안 되는 길을... 논의해야 한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.src: I am sorry... to welcome you all... in such troubled times.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.dst: 미안하다... 이렇게 어려운 때에... 너희를 맞이하게 되어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.src: We thought... we could hide in safety... But there is... no place left to hide.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.dst: 우리는... 숨으면 안전할 줄... 알았다... 하지만 이제... 숨을 곳이 없다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.src: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.dst: Aval은... 우리더러... 고원을 떠나라 한다... 하지만 우리는... 살아남지 못한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.src: We must... evacuate the settlement... immediately. They... are coming... again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.dst: 우리는... 즉시... 정착지를 떠나야 한다. 그들이... 또... 오고 있다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.src: Please! You all know me, I'm not with the side of the government. Hear me out, we can fix this!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.dst: 제발! 다들 날 알잖아, 난 정부 편이 아니야. 내 말 좀 들어 봐, 바로잡을 수 있어!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.src: Stop! I have been hiding from the Dwarves just as much as anyone here, they've been after me too!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.dst: 멈춰! 나도 여기 누구 못지않게 드워프들을 피해 숨어 왔어, 날 쫓고 있다고!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.src: Why... would we... trust you... of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.dst: 왜... 우리가... 믿어야 하지... 하필 드워프인 너를?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.src: How...could you even help? They...won't listen to you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.dst: 네가... 어떻게 돕겠다는 거냐? 그들은... 네 말을 듣지 않는다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.src: I know all the war strategies and weapon cache locations.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.dst: 전쟁 전략이랑 무기고 위치를 전부 알고 있어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.src: Treason... against your own kind...? How will you... manage this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.src: The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment, Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.dst: 나와 이 인간은 무기고에 잠입해서 장비를 망가뜨릴게. Korzim이 Dogun들을 더 안전한 곳으로 대피시켜 줄 거야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.src: I am... yet wary of you... but we will... follow your plan... Dwarf. Korzim... lead us... to safety.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.dst: 아직... 너를 경계한다... 하지만 우리는... 네 계획을 따르겠다... 드워프. Korzim... 우리를... 안전한 곳으로.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.src: {u}, follow the southern road from {p}, towards the {p} entrance. I'll be waiting there for you near the armoury.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.dst: {u}, {p}에서 남쪽 길을 따라 {p} 입구 쪽으로 와. 무기고 근처에서 기다릴게.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.src: Shh! Get behind here, and look towards the armoury doors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.dst: 쉿! 여기 뒤로 숨어서 무기고 문 쪽을 봐.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.src: We need to sneak in when they aren't looking, got it? But we need to be fast.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.dst: 저들이 안 볼 때 몰래 들어가야 해, 알겠지? 대신 빨라야 해.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.src: If they close that door, we'll only have one option left, and it's a huge risk. Those Dwarven gates are almost unbreakable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.dst: 저 문이 닫히면 남는 방법은 하나뿐인데, 위험이 엄청 커. 드워프의 관문은 거의 부술 수 없거든.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.src: Alright boys, let's close this up and head to base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.dst: 좋아, 다들 여기 닫고 B 기지로 가자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.speaker: Rodoroc Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.src: Aaah! Charge them! HEY, STOP RIGHT THERE, SOLDIERS!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.dst: 아아! 덮쳐! 이봐, 거기 서, 병사들!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.src: Defeat the {p} Guards outside the armory.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.src: It's the traitor! Capture them, now! There's only one reason they would be near the armoury!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.dst: 배신자다! 당장 붙잡아! 무기고 근처에 올 이유는 하나뿐이야!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.speaker: Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.src: Is that all of them? We're out of danger, at least, but they still shut the door, damn it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.dst: 다 처리했나? 일단 위험은 벗어났는데, 결국 문을 닫아 버렸어, 젠장!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.src: Gah, all that for nothing! You're not too banged up, are you?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.dst: 으, 헛수고였잖아! 너 많이 다치진 않았지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.src: Well, I said there's another way, but it's not a guarantee. Hurry, follow me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.dst: 다른 길이 있다고 했지만, 확실하진 않아. 서둘러, 따라와.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.src: Urgh, damn it. They almost never bother to close this door, and now of all times...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.dst: 으, 젠장. 이 문은 거의 안 닫는데, 하필 이럴 때...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.src: There's nothing for it. They'll be sending reinforcements soon, we need a way through here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.dst: 어쩔 수 없지. 곧 지원군이 올 테니, 여길 뚫고 갈 방법이 필요해.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.src: Those black bricks look breakable...but that won't solve the door, will it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.dst: 저 검은 벽돌은 부술 수 있어 보이는데... 그래도 문은 못 넘잖아?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.src: Find a way to break through the black bricks outside the wooden door.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.dst: 나무 문 밖의 검은 벽돌을 부술 방법을 찾으세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.src: Alright, let's destroy these machines! You see the two cannons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.dst: 좋아, 이 기계들을 부수자! 대포 두 대 보여?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.src: If you use rocks as ammo, you'll destroy the machine it's aiming at, but if you use tnt, it'll selfdestruct. Good luck
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.dst: 돌을 탄약으로 쓰면 조준한 기계를 부수고, TNT를 쓰면 대포가 자폭해. 행운을 빌어
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city, the {p} Power Core.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.dst: Axelus를 따라 {p} 깊숙이 들어가 도시의 동력원인 {p} Power Core를 파괴하세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.src: Nice work! That will slow them down. We're not done yet, we need to pay the king a visit. Let's head further into {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.dst: 잘했어! 이걸로 좀 늦춰지겠지. 아직 안 끝났어, 왕을 찾아가야 해. {p} 안쪽으로 더 가자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.src: Hurry! Through here, to the power core!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.src: This is a geothermal power core. If we can disrupt it, it should slow them down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.dst: 이건 지열 동력 핵이야. 이걸 망가뜨리면 저들을 늦출 수 있을 거야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.src: The hypocrites used Dogun magic to make this... It's lucky, honestly. I know how to work it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.dst: 위선자들이 Dogun 마법으로 이걸 만들었지... 솔직히 운이 좋아. 다루는 법을 알거든.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.src: ...hell, they already rallied?! That's the army!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.src: That sounds like an entire battalion!! How did they know I was going after this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.dst: 대대 하나가 통째로 온 소리야!! 내가 이걸 노리는 걸 어떻게 알았지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.src: Dogun magic is slow! Keep me defended, this'll take awhile!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.dst: Dogun 마법은 느려! 날 지켜 줘, 시간이 좀 걸려!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.src: Grr, this is harder than I thought!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.src: Ah! Don't let them get too close!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.dst: 아! 너무 가까이 못 오게 해!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.src: I hate that you're having to fight my people, but I wouldn't be asking for help if it weren't needed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.dst: 내 동족과 싸우게 해서 마음이 안 좋아. 하지만 꼭 필요하지 않았다면 부탁 안 했어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.src: Hm...the slums should be behind this wall here. We'll lose them there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.dst: 흠... 이 벽 뒤가 빈민가일 거야. 거기서 따돌리자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.src: The power's down, but...that cannon should do to get us through. You know how to operate it, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.dst: 동력은 끊겼지만... 저 대포면 뚫고 갈 수 있을 거야. 다룰 줄 알지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.src: Dwarvern society isn't as great as they make it out to be. The poorest are hidden away.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.dst: 드워프 사회는 떠드는 것만큼 대단하지 않아. 가장 가난한 이들은 숨겨져 있지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.src: The coalition has helped these people through some hard times, we can trust them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.dst: 연합이 이 사람들이 힘들 때 도와줬어. 믿어도 돼.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.src: There's a reason I brought us here. The sewer system is connected to the royal palace. All the way to the kings bathroom.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.dst: 여기로 온 이유가 있어. 하수도가 왕궁과 연결돼 있거든. 왕의 욕실까지 쭉.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.src: We need to find a way to ignite this explosive. Can you take a look around?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.dst: 이 폭약에 불붙일 방법을 찾아야 해. 주변 좀 살펴봐 줄래?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.src: Find a way to enter the sewer system.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.src: If we can convince the king that it’s not worth the fight, he may back down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.dst: 싸울 가치가 없다고 왕을 설득하면, 물러설지도 몰라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.src: I'm a little ashamed to admit I know my way round the sewers by now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.dst: 부끄럽지만 이젠 하수도 길을 훤히 알아.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.src: You have to understand.. The people truly think the Doguns are evil incarnate. But the king knows better.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.dst: 알아 둬.. 백성들은 Dogun이 진짜 악의 화신이라고 믿어. 하지만 왕은 진실을 알지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.src: Enter the Royal Palace through the sewer pipe and find the king.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.dst: 하수도 관을 통해 왕궁에 들어가 왕을 찾으세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.src: Don't let the guards catch you. Stay out of sight, got it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.dst: 경비병에게 들키지 마. 눈에 띄지 말고, 알겠지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.src: Sneak past the guards and talk to the Dwarven King.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.dst: 경비병을 몰래 지나쳐 드워프 왕에게 말을 거세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.src: I can't say I'm surprised, Axelus. Guards, let them be.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.dst: 놀랍다고는 못 하겠구나, Axelus. 경비병, 내버려 둬라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.src: You know why I'm here, father. We haven't got any more chances to stop this.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.dst: 제가 왜 왔는지 아시잖아요, 아버지. 이걸 막을 기회는 더 없어요.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.src: Axelus, you know why we have to maintain the lie. Think about the people, how they would react.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.dst: Axelus, 우리가 왜 거짓말을 지켜야 하는지 알 텐데. 백성들이 어떻게 반응할지 생각해 봐라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.src: We can not be responsible for the lies of our ancestors! This is ridiculous and you know it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.dst: 조상들의 거짓말을 우리가 책임질 순 없어요! 말도 안 되는 거, 아버지도 아시잖아요!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.src: Axelus, if the people found out, everything would descend to chaos. There would be riots, revolutions!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.dst: Axelus, 백성들이 알게 되면 모든 게 혼돈에 빠진다. 폭동이, 혁명이 일어날 거다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.src: If you hadn't turned traitor and gone gallivanting off with the Doguns, you would be in a better position to convince me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.dst: 네가 배신자가 되어 Dogun들과 쏘다니지만 않았어도, 날 설득할 입장이 좀 더 나았을 거다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.src: As it is now, you are too little and too late. The war has already begun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.dst: 지금 너는 힘도 없고 너무 늦었다. 전쟁은 이미 시작됐어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.src: The armoury that a certain someone decided to sabotage won't make any difference.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.dst: 누군가가 망가뜨리기로 한 그 무기고도 아무 차이를 못 만들 거다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.src: You will commit genocide so you don't have to face the consequences of your lies?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.dst: 거짓말의 대가를 피하려고 한 종족을 몰살하시겠다고요?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.src: I will be the hero of our nation, and my name will forever be remembered as the King who brought peace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.dst: 나는 나라의 영웅이 될 거다. 내 이름은 평화를 가져온 왕으로 영원히 기억되겠지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.src: I have nothing left to say to you. See yourselves out behind the throne. I'll let you use the trading tunnel to {p} in the southern caves, if you just step back and let me handle things.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.dst: 더 할 말은 없다. 왕좌 뒤로 알아서 나가라. 네가 물러서서 내게 맡긴다면, 남쪽 동굴에 있는 {p}행 교역 터널을 쓰게 해 주마.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.src: I'm not giving up on this. I'm going back in, I know he can be reasoned with!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.dst: 난 포기 안 해. 다시 들어갈 거야, 아버지도 설득할 수 있어!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.src: Give this letter to Korzim in the Dogun village when you reach level {~}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.dst: 레벨 {~}이 되면 Dogun 마을의 Korzim에게 이 편지를 전해 줘.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.src: I'm going to have one last talk with my father.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000~1.src: The Royal Guards escort you and Axelus out of the palace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000~1.dst: 왕실 근위병들이 당신과 Axelus를 궁전 밖으로 호송한다.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001~1.src: Aval...would have us...leave the Heights... But we...would not survive...in large numbers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001~1.dst: Aval은... 우리더러... 고원을 떠나라 하지만... 우리는... 많은 수로는... 살아남지 못한다.

similar.text: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003~1.src: You are so young...to be fighting...a war so old. Still...it is appreciated.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003~1.dst: 그렇게 어린데... 그토록 오래된... 전쟁을 치르다니. 그래도... 고맙게 여긴다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003~1.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004~1.src: Why...would we trust... Why...would we trust... you...of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004~1.dst: 왜... 우리가 믿어야... 왜... 우리가 믿어야 하지... 하필... 드워프인 너를?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006~1.src: The war...to you, it would be...ages ago. But...when one has lived for...{~} years...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006~1.dst: 그 전쟁은... 너에게는... 까마득한 옛일이겠지. 하지만... {~}년을... 살아온 자에게는...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006~1.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007~1.src: Are you lost? Why would anyone ever come down here?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007~1.dst: 길을 잃었어? 누가 대체 이 아래까지 내려오겠어?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010~1.src: I am sorry...to welcome you all...in such troubled times.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010~1.dst: 미안하다... 이렇게 어려운 때에... 너희를 맞이하게 되어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010~1.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013~1.src: We must...evacuate the settlement...immediately. They...are coming...again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013~1.dst: 우리는... 즉시... 정착지를 떠나야 한다. 그들이... 또... 오고 있다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013~1.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014~1.src: [New Quest Started: Dwarves and Doguns Part II]

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015~1.src: If you can get up there you can help yourself to it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015~1.dst: 저기까지 올라갈 수 있으면 마음대로 가져가.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025~1.src: The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment. Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025~1.dst: 나와 이 인간은 무기고에 잠입해서 장비를 망가뜨릴게. Korzim이 Dogun들을 더 안전한 곳으로 대피시켜 줄 거야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025~1.speaker: Axelus
